subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: For corrupted or unreadable session-store JSON that makes Telegram/status appear empty or broken, should OpenClaw add read-only diagnostics plus a backed-up reset command, or also auto-quarantine/recover at load time?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but automatic recovery changes persisted session continuity and overlaps with the generic session-store recovery work in #77783/#79910.

options.title: Diagnose and reset explicitly
options.body: Status/doctor should flag unreadable or zero-byte session state and offer a backed-up reset/quarantine command without mutating runtime state automatically.

options.title: Auto-quarantine on load
options.body: The loader would move bad primary state aside and recover automatically, improving availability but accepting automatic persisted-state mutation.

options.title: Fold into generic recovery
options.body: Maintainers could make #77783/#79910 the only recovery track and keep this issue only if Telegram-specific status UX remains after that lands.

recommendation.title: Diagnose and reset explicitly
recommendation.body: Status/doctor should flag unreadable or zero-byte session state and offer a backed-up reset/quarantine command without mutating runtime state automatically.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the current session-store loader split and are the best available routing owner for deciding the loader/status boundary.
